# Live dashboard

The dashboard opens first and watches the disk; nothing polls on a timer.

## Blocks

1. files: size, count, and lines per extension
   - folders first, then extensions
2. diffs: `+n/m -x/y` for staged and unstaged lines
3. tasks: done against total, per kind

> Watch the agent change the project, step in when needed, and go back to
> the dashboard without stopping it.

## Keys

~~~~text
f - files
d - diffs
## a heading inside a tilde fence
~~~
~~~~

| key | screen |
| --- | ------ |
| t   | tasks  |
| r   | run    |

### Échéances ✓

- [ ] a checkbox in a plain document is a task
- not a task, just a list item
